title: Most news apps guess what you want based on what you click.
body:
That approach is flawed. Clicking on a sensational headline doesn't mean you actually care about the topic. It often just means the headline was designed to grab your attention for a split second.

At Headlinne, we built our recommendation engine differently. Instead of tracking fleeting clicks, we focus on the stories you read from start to finish. We look at the depth of your engagement. If you read a complex piece about climate policy or local infrastructure all the way through, that tells us something real about your interests. It is about quality over quantity.

We also know that interests change. You might be obsessed with tech news this month but focused on urban planning the next. Our AI adapts to those shifts in real time. It does not box you into a permanent category based on a search you made three years ago.

Building a news feed this way takes more work, but it respects your time. It means your feed stays relevant to who you are today, not who you were last week.
cta: See how a more thoughtful feed feels at HEADLINNE.com.
